properties.name: CBCBLR004
properties.site-address: 44 Goffs Park Road, (formerly Oakhurst Grange), Southgate, Crawley
properties.notes: Site benefits from Planning permissions CR/2016/0972/FUL for 'Demolition of existing buildings and erection of a continuing care retirement community (class C2)' (now technically commenced due to demolition of existing buildings on site) and CR/2019/0642/FUL for 'Erection of an electricity sub-station & alterations to the parking layout in relation to planning permission CR/2016/0972/FUL as amended by CR/2016/0972/NM1' (granted 21/11/2019). Allocated in Policy H2 of the 2015 Local Plan as ‘housing for older people’. This allocation is proposed for retention in Policy H2 of the Regulation 19 draft of the Local Plan Review document. Development of this site should therefore specifically meet the needs of older people, either as a residential care home (C2) or as general housing (C3) which is designed to meet the needs of older people to meet the building regulations part M category 3. The broader design and layout of development on this site should also give specific consideration to the requirements of older people. Minimum figure of 0 reflects planning permission CR/2016/0972/FUL which is for non housing development rather than Class C3 housing. Maximum figure of 55 is based on allocation figure in Local Plan Policy H2 (Key Housing sites) (C3 scenario).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
